moments.title: Big TV for Monday Night
moments.blurb: Tonight's TV schedule is packed with major shows including a double wedding on EastEnders, the finale of Vigil, and the return of Colin from Accounts for its third series.

angles.name: EastEnders drama
angles.copy: Double wedding drama in Albert Square tonight! EastEnders is bringing the fireworks. Who's tuning in for the big day(s)?

angles.name: Vigil finale
angles.copy: Tonight's the night! The gripping finale of Vigil airs at 9 PM. Are you ready for answers or more twists?

angles.name: Colin from Accounts return
angles.copy: Gordon and Ashley are back! Season 3 of the brilliant Colin from Accounts premieres tonight on BBC Two. Get ready to laugh.

moments.title: Tom Bailey (Thompson Twins) in Exeter
moments.blurb: Tom Bailey, the voice of The Thompson Twins, brings his unique fusion of pop and new wave to Exeter tonight.

angles.name: Local gig alert
angles.copy: Tonight in Exeter! Tom Bailey of The Thompson Twins is live, bringing all those 80s synth-pop vibes. Who's got their tickets?

angles.name: 80s throwback
angles.copy: Hold your horses, Exeter! The legendary Tom Bailey of The Thompson Twins is in town tonight. Get ready for some classic 80s hits!

moments.title: Swansea Jazz Festival Wraps Up
moments.blurb: The Swansea International Jazz Festival has just wrapped up its four-day run, bringing international and local jazz artists to multiple venues across the city.

angles.name: Festival reflection
angles.copy: What a weekend for Swansea! The International Jazz Festival brought incredible music and atmosphere to the city. Did you catch any of the gigs?

angles.name: Local highlight
angles.copy: The sound of jazz filled Swansea for four days! Huge shout out to everyone who made the International Jazz Festival such a success. A true highlight for the city.

moments.title: Official Singles Chart Update
moments.blurb: The latest Official UK Singles Chart for September 5th sees Olivia Dean holding strong at Number 1 with 'Man I Need', while Ella Langley's 'Choosin' Texas' also topped the chart this month.

angles.name: Chart topper
angles.copy: Still reigning supreme! Olivia Dean's 'Man I Need' is holding onto the Number 1 spot on the Official UK Singles Chart. What a track!

angles.name: New entries & climbers
angles.copy: It's been a busy week on the charts! Ella Langley's 'Choosin' Texas' hit Number 1, plus new entries from Taylor Swift and Dolly Parton making a comeback. What's your favourite right now?

moments.title: Happy Birthday, Pink!
moments.blurb: Pop icon Pink (Alecia Moore) celebrates her 47th birthday on September 8th.

angles.name: Pop Queen
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 47th birthday to the incredible Pink tomorrow! An absolute powerhouse of pop. What's your favourite Pink track?

angles.name: Hit after hit
angles.copy: Tomorrow, we celebrate the birthday of the one and only Pink! From 'Get The Party Started' to 'Cover Me In Sunshine', she's given us so many anthems.

moments.title: Happy Birthday, Aimee Mann!
moments.blurb: Singer-songwriter Aimee Mann, known for her solo work and 'Til Tuesday, turns 66 on September 8th.

angles.name: Indie icon
angles.copy: Happy 66th Birthday tomorrow to the brilliant Aimee Mann! A true singer-songwriter legend. 'Voices Carry' is still a classic.

moments.title: Happy Birthday, David Steele!
moments.blurb: David Steele, bassist and co-founder of Fine Young Cannibals, celebrates his 66th birthday on September 8th.

angles.name: Fine Young Cannibals legend
angles.copy: Tomorrow, we're celebrating David Steele of Fine Young Cannibals' 66th birthday! Responsible for some serious 80s grooves.

moments.title: Happy Birthday, Wiz Khalifa!
moments.blurb: American rapper Wiz Khalifa turns 39 on September 8th.

angles.name: Rap star birthday
angles.copy: Get ready to celebrate! It's Wiz Khalifa's 39th birthday tomorrow. Drop your favourite track of his!

moments.title: Strictly Come Dancing is Back!
moments.blurb: Strictly Come Dancing returns for its 24th series with a launch show on September 19th, featuring new hosts Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe.

angles.name: Strictly buzz
angles.copy: Dust off your dancing shoes! Strictly Come Dancing returns on September 19th with a brand new lineup of hosts. Who are you most excited to see?

angles.name: New hosts reaction
angles.copy: Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe are taking over Strictly hosting duties! Big changes for the new series starting September 19th. What do we think?

moments.title: Bake Off Returns with New Judge!
moments.blurb: The Great British Bake Off is set to return on September 22nd, with Nigella Lawson joining as a new judge alongside Paul Hollywood.

angles.name: Bake Off is back
angles.copy: Get ready to pre-heat those ovens! The Great British Bake Off returns September 22nd. Who's excited for soggy bottoms and showstoppers?

angles.name: Nigella joins Bake Off
angles.copy: Huge news for Bake Off fans! Nigella Lawson is joining the judging panel this series, starting September 22nd. We can't wait to see what she brings to the tent!

moments.title: Shale Live at Exeter Cavern
moments.blurb: Exeter Cavern hosts Shale and supports on Wednesday, September 9th.

angles.name: Local rock gig
angles.copy: Midweek music alert for Exeter! Shale are playing the Cavern this Wednesday, Sept 9th. Get your tickets now!

moments.title: Baga Chipz: Bagz to Riches in Exeter
moments.blurb: Drag Race UK star Baga Chipz brings her 'Bagz to Riches' show to Exeter's Barnfield Theatre on Thursday, September 10th.

angles.name: Drag star in Exeter
angles.copy: Much Betta! Baga Chipz is bringing her 'Bagz to Riches' show to Exeter's Barnfield Theatre this Thursday, Sept 10th. Expect laughs and pure entertainment!

angles.name: Local entertainment
angles.copy: Thursday night plans sorted! The fabulous Baga Chipz is live in Exeter at the Barnfield Theatre. Get ready for a show!

moments.title: Private Peaceful at Exeter Northcott
moments.blurb: The acclaimed play 'Private Peaceful' runs at the Exeter Northcott Theatre from Wednesday, September 9th to Thursday, September 10th.

angles.name: Theatre in Exeter
angles.copy: Don't miss 'Private Peaceful' at the Exeter Northcott Theatre, running Wednesday and Thursday. A powerful story on stage.

moments.title: Wild Oceans Live in Exeter
moments.blurb: Wild Oceans perform with guests at Exeter Cavern on Friday, September 11th.

angles.name: Weekend gig start
angles.copy: Kick off your weekend early! Wild Oceans are playing Exeter Cavern this Friday, Sept 11th. Get ready for some live music!

angles.name: Punk rock night
angles.copy: Get ready for a dose of 1977 punk! London (UK 1977 Punk) are at Exeter Cavern this Saturday, Sept 12th. Don't miss it!
